methodologyNotes: Adversarially re-verified roster of 13 rotary-tool models (corded + cordless), each cross-checked against official manufacturer pages (dremel.com, shop.dremel.com, wenproducts.com, genesispowertools.com, milwaukeetool.com), press-release wires (PRNewswire, BusinessWire), and reputable retailers/reviewers (Home Depot, Walmart, Lowe's, Tool Nut, Acme Tools, ToolGuyd, Pro Tool Reviews, Ohio Power Tool). priceUsd = published US MSRP at launch or current published US retail for the EXACT SKU named; null where no published USD price could be confirmed. Booleans reflect confirmed feature presence; null = unconfirmed. Speed ranges are 'min-max RPM' strings; included_accessories_count is the integer accessory count for the named base/standard SKU. accessedAt 2026-06-20. Corrections applied this pass: Dremel 3000 speed corrected from 5,000-35,000 to the official US 5,000-32,000 RPM; Dremel 4000 ez_change_accessories corrected false->true (4000 ships with EZ Twist nose cap); two thin/affiliate corroboration URLs (toolguide.com, tacklifeinfo.com) replaced with reputable retailer listings. No products were fabricated; all 13 exist and were retained.

products.name: Dremel 4300 Variable Speed Corded Rotary Tool
products.priceNote: MSRP, 4300-5/40 base kit at launch (Feb 2017 press release); 4300-9/64 platinum kit MSRP $199.99
products.provenance: Release date (February 2, 2017) and MSRP ($119.99 standard / $199.99 platinum) confirmed from the PRNewswire press release. Amps (1.8 A) and speed range (5,000–35,000 RPM) confirmed from official Dremel product page and Ace/Lowe's listings (1.8-amp). Accessories count (40) confirmed for the 4300-5/40 kit. Universal three-jaw chuck / EZ change confirmed.

products.name: Dremel 4000 Variable Speed Corded Rotary Tool
products.priceNote: MSRP, 4000-2/32 kit; typical current US retail $71–$99
products.provenance: Amps (1.6 A) and speed range (5,000–35,000 RPM) confirmed from official Dremel 4000-2/32 page and Home Depot listing. Accessories count (32) confirmed for the 4000-2/32 kit. CORRECTION: ez_change_accessories changed false->true — the Dremel 4000 ships with and is marketed around the EZ Twist nose cap with integrated wrench (confirmed on the official 4000 marketing page); the prior 'false' was inconsistent with the 3000/8220 entries which share the same EZ Twist feature. Source URL switched from a press-release path that did not resolve to the live official product page.

products.name: Dremel 3000 Variable Speed Corded Rotary Tool
products.priceNote: Typical current US retail (3000-1/24 kit); no single published MSRP
products.provenance: CORRECTION: speed_range_rpm 5,000–35,000 -> 5,000–32,000 and max_rpm 35000 -> 32000. The US Dremel 3000 spec is 5,000–32,000 RPM (1.2 A, 120 V), confirmed by Home Depot, Hubbard Supply, Advanced Safety Supply, and the Gadgeteer 2011 review; the prior 35,000 figure was wrong (35k belongs to the 4000/4300/8220). Amps (1.2 A) and 24-accessory 3000-1/24 kit confirmed. EZ Twist nose cap confirmed (ez_change true). Release year 2011 corroborated (replaced the Dremel 300).

products.name: Dremel 8260 Brushless Smart Cordless Rotary Tool
products.priceNote: MSRP at launch (announced Dec 2021, in-store Feb 2022); current street price lower
products.provenance: Launch (announced Dec 2, 2021; available Feb 2022) and MSRP ($169.99) confirmed via ToolGuyd and Pro Tool Reviews. Brushless motor + Bluetooth smart-app connectivity confirmed (Dremel's first brushless/smart rotary tool). Speed range 5,000–30,000 RPM and 3.0Ah 12V battery confirmed (Walmart/Pro Tool Reviews). Base 8260-5 kit ships 5 accessories. Corroboration switched to Pro Tool Reviews (the global Dremel 'gn' page lists EU-market specs).

products.name: Dremel 8240 Cordless Rotary Tool

Base 8240-5 kit ships 5 accessories.
